nodes.label: TandemPay Splash Screen Icon
nodes.description: Mobile app splash screen / loading screen icon for TandemPay. Features a minimalist design with three concentric circles (rings) centered on a white background with a subtle grid overlay. The concentric circle motif in light grey suggests connection, synchronization, or signal — visually consistent with a payments or tandem/sync-themed brand identity. No text or wordmark is present; this is a purely geometric logo mark used as the app loading screen graphic.
